description: Published contract award results matching a supplier, buyer, country, CPV or date range: each award with winners, their country and size, award and tender values with currency, decision and contract dates and the buyer. Plus an aggregate per currency (count, sum, median, sample size and date range); amounts are never added across currencies and notices without a value are counted as missing. Price: 0.02 USDC per call, paid with x402 (USDC on Base or Solana, no account, no API key); invalid input is refused before payment and a failed run is never charged. Without a payment the tool returns the x402 PaymentRequired. Free sample answer: get_example {"tool":"tenders_get_awards"}. Same tool over HTTP: https://yruz.one/api/tenders/awards?country=RS&limit=10

country.description: buyer country, ISO code (DE, DEU, RS, SRB ...)

cpv.description: CPV code or prefix, 2-8 digits, e.g. 72 or 72000000

q.description: keywords in the notice text, e.g. cloud software
